notes.title: Patch time.
notes.notes:
Hi text adventure fans,

We've made a few minor changes to Stranded 2 following feedback from players. Here's a list.

Fixed a number of small, annoying bugs.
Fixed a global typo, and a couple of others.
Reduced the weight of small objects for better realism, so you can carry more.
Improved the player death routine.

That's it,

Enjoy,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Where's the percentage in that?
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Following some feedback, we've fixed a couple of non-game breaking bugs, including an issue where in some cases the score percentage wasn't being displayed correctly.

We've also made some improvements to the PUSH/PULL system.

Enjoy, and thanks for your support.

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Whoops and more.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

In keeping with our pledge to always be the best we can, we've released a small number of fixes to address a few reported issues. With a game as complex as Stranded 2, that allows for such a range of inputs, we're not surprised that some of you will try things that we or our beta testers didn't envisige. 

This build fixes 2 small reported bugs and also improves the response when trying to use an inappropriate object for a situation.

Thanks for the reports,

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: STRANDED 2 releases into the wild!
notes.notes:
Stranded 2, our second text adventure has landed today and brings another taste of classic text-based puzzling to Steam. For an extra retro feel, we've included the original game, from the same author, released in 1991 for the ZX Spectrum, so you can see where it all began.

Stranded 2 is a text-based puzzle adventure, lovingly created to bring parser-based fun to the masses and is Inspired by some of the greatest interactive fiction games of the 1980s and 1990s.

Although the initial release is for PC, we've tested Stranded 2 on Mac and it will run under Crossfire.

If you love text-based puzzles, or just fancy a huge dollop of nostalgia, you'll love Stranded 2.

The JimJams Games team.
